scope: Content interpretation, colour, functions, forms, optional content and page transforms checked against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text. Implemented transparency in clause 11, analytic/mesh shadings, shading and tiling patterns in 8.7, annotation appearances, generated link/square/note shapes and view flags in 12.5 and continuous-tone halftone bypass in 10.6 are covered by independent fixtures. Exact-area bytes, Bradford adaptation, sRGB output and rounding are project policy. ICC tag processing awaits primary ICC-text review.

requirements.gaps: calibrated group blending and subtractive overprint remain incomplete
requirements.rule: Graphics-state changes, construction, painting and clipping follow Tables 51, 52 and 58 through 60; the current path is separate from saved graphics state.

requirements.rule: Supported embedded source profiles are processed rather than replaced by Alternate. ICCBased source components initialize to zero; only later unsupported profile versions use an alternate. ICC v2.0–2.4 and v4.0–4.3 Gray/RGB matrix/TRC tag definitions, including parametric and sampled curves, are implemented with independent formula oracles pending primary ICC-text review. Bradford PCS-D50 adaptation, relative-colorimetric fallback and sRGB output are project policy.
requirements.status: source matrix/TRC processing; tag definitions pending primary ICC-text review
requirements.gaps: LUT profiles; calibrated group inverse transforms; nondefault ranges; primary ICC specification not locally available

requirements.rule: All complements its tint on additive devices and applies the same tint to every group colourant. None contributes no shape, opacity or colour. All-None DeviceN discards output; mixed alternate transforms receive None inputs. All is forbidden in DeviceN.
requirements.status: special colourants and alternate semantics
requirements.gaps: NChannel component-specific colour management remains unsupported

requirements.rule: Pattern spaces may name coloured cells or include an underlying space for uncoloured stencils. Cell resources, BBox, matrix and nonzero lattice steps control placement. Restricted colour setters and non-stencil images are ignored in uncoloured cells. The pattern forms one non-isolated group; outer alpha and blend apply once. Integer lattice fitting, pixel coverage and rounding are project policies.
requirements.status: bounded cell compilation, visible-instance enumeration and non-isolated composition
requirements.gaps: singular/collapsed device lattices and Type 1 fitting beyond one pixel remain explicit; pattern-coloured image stencils await the image compositor

requirements.rule: Undefined dictionary keys do not change graphics state. Defined entries retain validation and explicit unsupported handling. Continuous-tone RGB has no halftone origin; black point compensation OFF and the processor Default disable compensation.
requirements.status: unknown extension entries ignored; HTO validated; explicit black-point-compensation boundary
requirements.gaps: UseBlackPtComp ON remains unsupported

requirements.rule: Visible link and square borders remain inside Rect. BS overrides Border. Zero-width borders and absent interior colours are transparent. Seven note icons have geometric appearances selected by project device policy; exact-area coverage and channel rounding are project policies.
requirements.status: link/square appearance generation and predefined note icons
requirements.gaps: rounded and relief borders, square BE/RD and other annotation appearance generation remain explicit

requirements.rule: NoZoom preserves screen dimensions and NoRotate preserves orientation about the transformed upper-left Rect corner. Text notes use both flags implicitly. Fixed screen size at 72 dpi at unit magnification, preserving UserUnit is project device policy.
requirements.status: view-aware high-precision annotation groups
requirements.gaps: interactive popup windows are outside the rendering API

requirements.rule: Group compositing preserves high-precision colour, shape and alpha within the intersection of conservative source/BBox bounds, hard clip bounds and the device tile. Fixed-size page backdrop chunks and allocation accounting are project memory policies; they do not change source geometry.
requirements.status: bounded group regions and chunked page backdrop with a shared work budget
requirements.gaps: soft-mask value arrays span the active device chunk

requirements.rule: Mesh records decode coordinates and components, honour byte padding and reuse preceding edges. Triangles interpolate barycentrically; patches interpolate corner components bilinearly in their bicubic parameter space. Functions run after interpolation. Later patches take precedence; folds select largest v then u. Pixel-centre sampling, numeric root tolerance and byte rounding are project policies. Patch inversion uses a 2^-24 parameter subdivision floor and a 1e-9 tie tolerance for coincident v roots; these are project numeric policies.
requirements.status: spatially indexed triangle and bicubic mesh evaluation
requirements.gaps: numerically unresolved patch inverses fail explicitly under the mesh tag; work and memory are bounded

requirements.rule: Subtractive overprint requires per-colourant selection and overprint-mode semantics before compositing; converting a source to RGB or a dense CMYK vector loses this information.
requirements.status: explicit unsupported for CMYK group overprint
requirements.gaps: CMYK output-intent simulation is deferred: retained colours lack colourant-write masks/OPM and the engine does not process CMYK ICC LUT profiles. Accepting this input as ordinary source-over would erase underlying inks.
